attribution_rule: Several factors move together by design. No outcome may be attributed to any single factor, and this arm may not be presented as a controlled contrast against the rank-0, LoRA, or last-4 partial-unfreeze arms.
confounded_factors: discriminative-LR direction INVERTED to SAM-Med3D's own (encoder above heads)
N4 bias field correction added to preprocessing
max epochs 50 -> 200 with official MultiStepLR([120,180], gamma 0.1)
effective batch 2 -> 12 (per-GPU 2 x 2 GPUs x 3 accumulation)
single-GPU -> 2-GPU data parallelism with explicit gradient all-reduce

test.status: PERMANENTLY FROZEN; not read, not evaluated, not used for selection

initialization.note: untouched base; not initialized from any prior arm

evidence: SAM-Med3D train.py trains image_encoder at full LR, heads at 0.1x
project results monotone in encoder adaptation: 0.4785 frozen -> 0.5214 LoRA -> 0.5072 by epoch 7 for blocks 8-11
the prohibition carried no supporting experiment and was grouped with test-hacking techniques

model.trainable_policy: FULL unfreeze: entire image encoder + prompt encoder + mask decoder

objective: Follow SAM-Med3D's own published training recipe -- full image-encoder unfreeze with the encoder learning rate above the heads, plus its epoch budget and decay schedule -- on the frozen 972/108 clean-development split, to see how far the T1ce->WT arm moves toward the SAM-Med3D BraTS 2024 DSC of 74.1 +/- 1.5 that DPD-SAM reports. That baseline was most plausibly produced with this same official recipe, which is why it is the recipe being followed here rather than DPD-SAM's own frozen-backbone method.

optimization.lr_rationale: SAM-Med3D's 8e-4 belongs to ITS effective batch of 240 (batch 12 x accumulation 20), which on 972 cases would give only ~4 optimizer steps/epoch. Absolute LR is not transplantable; 1e-4/1e-5 is a conservative sqrt-scaling to effective batch 12. Only the 10:1 direction and the decay schedule are inherited.
optimization.memory_measured: 11.35 GiB peak at per-GPU batch 2; batch 4 OOMs on a 23 GB A10

preprocessing.augmentation: NOT cached; applied per-epoch by the dataset
preprocessing.normalization: source nonzero-voxel population z-score before resize
preprocessing.skull_stripping: not applied; BraTS 2024 volumes are already stripped

prohibitions: no threshold / TTA / morphology / connected-component / postprocess search
no encoder change beyond the full unfreeze authorized for this arm
no mid-run change of LR, unfreeze depth, augmentation, epoch cap or patience

readout.evaluation_preprocessing_caveat: This arm is trained on N4-corrected inputs, so it must also be evaluated on N4-corrected inputs to avoid a train/eval preprocessing mismatch. The LoRA and rank-0 reference values were produced WITHOUT N4. The reference numbers therefore sit on different model inputs, which is an additional reason this is a descriptive context comparison and not a controlled contrast.
readout.evaluation_protocol: Same 108 cases / 50 subjects, same case-seeded PCG64 click sampling and validation seed 20260723, same subject-balanced aggregation as the existing paired evaluator; only the image source changes (N4 cache instead of on-the-fly preprocessing).
readout.interpretation_limit: Reaching any particular value on this validation set does NOT reproduce the DPD-SAM-reported 74.1: that number was measured by different authors, on their own split, under a prompt protocol their paper does not disclose.
readout.primary: 108-case clean-validation subject-balanced C3 via independent strict reload

selection_rule.forbidden: no selection on train metrics, no test access
selection_rule.rule: strict argmax over completed epochs; ties keep the earlier epoch
